definitions.explanation: A piece of land surrounded by water. Japan itself is an island nation (島国) composed of many islands.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{島国|しまぐに}です。
あの{島|しま}に{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: I want to go to that island.

examples.japanese: {沖縄|おきなわ}にはたくさんの{島|しま}があります。
examples.english: There are many islands in Okinawa.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}に{島|しま}へ{泳|およ}ぎに{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to an island to swim in the summer.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}には{人|ひと}が{住|す}んでいないので、とても{静|しず}かで{自然|しぜん}がきれいです。
examples.english: No one lives on this island, so it's very quiet and the nature is beautiful.

notes: Japan has over 6,800 islands. Major islands include {本州|ほんしゅう} (Honshu), {北海道|ほっかいどう} (Hokkaido), {九州|きゅうしゅう} (Kyushu), and {四国|しこく} (Shikoku). The word appears in many place names.
